behaviors: The unchanged B1 empty executable pack and v1 identities remain exact
A full Division 23 executable pack compiles to order-independent canonical bytes and reopens from EngineStore with all executable indexes intact
Every rule resolves to a RULE_CANDIDATE definition and one GOVERNED_BY_RULE ontology relation
Every assembly edge resolves one allowed existing ontology relation and compilation rejects duplicate semantics, invalid dimensions, and cycles
Exact decimal and rational unit arithmetic never rounds and blocks impossible conversion or division
Missing observations or lookups produce explicit BLOCKED candidates while false conditions produce recorded deterministic omissions
Assembly traversal preserves relation paths and diamond contributions without global node deduplication
Airside/equipment and piping benchmark bundles produce deterministic cited lines spanning all Division 23 registry families
Labor and pricing remain separate non-authoritative candidates and fixture values are never represented as bid eligible
No drawing, provider, research, project, approval, quote, or bid authority enters B2

capability: Build a deterministic source-cited Division 23 calculation and assembly kernel for structured benchmark inputs across equipment, duct, pipe, fittings, valves, accessories, materials, connections, insulation, supports, labor, and pricing.

block.action: Block acceptance and preserve explicit benchmark-only limitations.
block.when: Benchmark fixture labor or pricing data is described as production-authoritative or bid eligible.

escalation.action: Report the exact failing behavior and perform at most one narrow correction; do not enter a repeated full-suite loop.
escalation.when: The single consolidated focused gate fails after substantive implementation.

reroute.action: Create an explicit replacement assignment without relabeling another provider's work.
reroute.when: The identified external builder cannot complete the bounded task.

stop.when: The patch writes P0 or P1A state, drawings, quantities, project prices, approvals, quotes, bids, provider state, or research state.

stop.action: Stop and replace the behavior with exact closed deterministic evaluation.
stop.when: Evaluation uses float, rounding, latest-pack lookup, callbacks, network, environment, filesystem, commands, or unbounded expressions.

deliverables: Airside/equipment and piping benchmark fixtures spanning every Division 23 family
Executable-pack store reopen and integrity validation
frozen_interfaces: B2 accepts BundleMode.BENCHMARK and rejects PROJECT_BOUND
CompiledDomainPack indexes units, observation definitions, lookups, assembly edges, and rules
Assembly edges bind existing relation_code values and do not duplicate ontology endpoints
Evaluation requires one explicit immutable CompiledDomainPack and never resolves latest
No float, rounding, external callback, provider, filesystem, command, environment, or URL evaluation
schema_impact: Extends canonical domain-pack-v2 executable arrays and adds an observation-bundle-v1 schema without adding or changing database tables
